text:
priya: heads-up — short embeddings (<32 tokens) in eu-west1 are returning intermittent 503s starting ~02:07 UTC, p99 spike. Looks like the quant optimization we merged yesterday. prepping a revert image (redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-rollback). Need a rapid approval path during the maintenance window.

nate: how widespread? are customers blocked?

priya: limited impact — roughly 2.5% of EU requests. A couple of premium customers reported degraded responses. No infra/network errors, just application 503s on the short path.

jen: will the revert affect caches or require warmup?

priya: KV prefix layout is backwards compatible but kernel change can cause prefix miss patterns for a short time. Plan: deploy revert, then run a prefix-cache drain+warm script for the embeddings pool. Expect a short warmup tail (~5-10m).

priya: proposed deploy: `/deploy request --service embeddings-eu --image redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-rollback --strategy canary=5%:3m --reason "short-embed 503 regression"`

deploy-bot: Deploy request 6487654321 created by priya. Approvals required: eng-leads + ops-oncall. Preflight: unit/integration PASS, smoke: WARNING (503 observed).

ops-bot: oncall notice sent to ops rotation.

nate: i'm available; i can approve for eng if ops oncall signs off. /approve 6487654321

jen: approve for QA/docs. I'll draft release note and support blurb. /approve 6487654321

ops-bot: ops-oncall (nate) acknowledged. Manual ops approval needed.

nate: approving ops contingent on a 5% canary for 3m, active monitoring, and immediate rollback gating. /approve 6487654321

deploy-bot: Approvals recorded: nate, jen. Starting canary: embeddings-eu -> redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-rollback at 5% for 180s. Logs: https://deploy.internal/logs/6487654321

priya: starting pool drain on canary subset then applying image: `kubectl set image deploy/embeddings-eu embeddings=redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-rollback -n prod-eu`

deploy-bot: Canary pods up. Observability: canary errors drop to 0, latency unchanged. Tracking traces for short-path calls.

nate: canary looks healthy from traces and dashboards. Green to ramp.

deploy-bot: Ramping to 25% for 240s.

priya: note — after ramp we'll run `infra/cache/drain --service embeddings-eu --pool default --grace 30s` then warm with sampled queries.

deploy-bot: 25% window complete; errors <0.1%, p95 latency +2ms. Starting rollout to 100%.

deploy-bot: Rollout progress: 35% -> 68% -> 100%. Post-deploy checks: healthchecks PASS, e2e-smoke PASS, no new alerts.

priya: completed prefix-cache drain and warm. Warm-up traffic flowed for ~8m. Monitoring shows stable error rate.

jen: filing release note: "Embeddings: reverted quant kernel to v2.3.2-rollback to mitigate 503s on short-embeddings in eu-west1. Canary ramp and cache warm performed; no customer-facing regression observed after rollout."

nate: filing incident ticket for RCA and follow-up action items to rework quant kernel.

priya: thanks everyone. closing once release note and incident ticket links are added. :white_check_mark:
